name: big-eyes-office
description: A local office of big-eyed AI agents: build teams from Claude, Codex and local models and run them from one UI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:build: npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop run build
